title: Distinguish uniform and non-uniform acceleration

hook.scenario: Aap ek ball ko chhat se niche girate ho, woh lagatar bina rukawat tez hoti rehti hai. Lekin jab aap car ko bheed mein chalate ho, toh kabhi ekdum speed dete ho aur kabhi achanak break.
hook.question: Dono cases mein speed badh rahi hai, par inke badhne ke 'style' mein kya basic difference hai?

mental_model.intuition: Uniform = Smooth aur predicted speed badhna. Non-uniform = Jhatke wali, unpredictable speed change.
mental_model.description: Agar kisi object ki velocity ek hi pattern mein (jaise har second +2, +2, +2 m/s) lagatar badh ya ghat rahi hai, toh use uniform kehte hain. Par agar kabhi +5, kabhi -2, kabhi +1 ho, toh yeh non-uniform hai.

explanation:
Humne padha ki acceleration ka matlab hai velocity ka badalna. Lekin kya velocity ek rhythm (tal) mein badal rahi hai, ya randomly? Isi buniyad par hum acceleration ko Uniform (ek saman) aur Non-uniform (asaman) me baant-te (categorize) hain.

Uniform acceleration tab hota hai jab koi object ek straight line mein chale aur uski velocity equal time intervals mein barabar amount se badhe (ya ghate). Iska sabse classic example hai 'free fall'. Jab aap ek patthar hawa se chhodte ho, gravity ki wajah se uski speed har second perfectly 9.8 m/s ke rate se badhti hai. Yeh smooth aur predictable hai, isliye iske liye hum equations of motion (v = u + at, etc.) directly use kar sakte hain.

Non-uniform acceleration tab hota hai jab velocity badalne ka rate alag-alag ho. Jaise kisi traffic wale raste par car chalana. Kabhi aap accelerator tez dabate ho (high acceleration), kabhi thoda sa (low acceleration). Velocity unequal amounts me change hoti hai. Aise non-uniform situations ke math ko handle karna thoda complex hota hai, isliye Class 9 ke syllabus mein maximum numericals sirf 'Uniform Acceleration' ke sikhaye jaate hain.

Graphical analysis me inka farq clear dikhta hai. Ek Velocity-Time graph me uniform acceleration ki line bilkul straight slanting (teerchi) aati hai. Par non-uniform acceleration ka graph ek aadi-tirchi (curved ya zig-zag) line banata hai.

key_points.title: Uniform Acceleration
key_points.detail: Velocity changes by equal amounts in equal intervals of time (e.g., a freely falling body).

key_points.title: Non-uniform Acceleration
key_points.detail: Velocity changes by unequal amounts in equal intervals of time (e.g., a car in traffic).

worked_example.problem: Observe the velocity of an object at every 1-second interval: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 m/s. Is this acceleration uniform?

steps.narration: Har second mein velocity ka change nikal kar check karte hain.
Kyunki har time interval mein change equal (+5 m/s) hai, acceleration uniform hai.

worked_example.problem: A car's speedometer reads 0, 2, 8, 11, 20 m/s at 1-second intervals. What type of motion is this?

steps.narration: Velocity mein change ko check karein.
Change unequal hai (kabhi 2, kabhi 6, kabhi 9). Iska matlab acceleration random hai.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing uniform velocity with uniform acceleration
common_mistakes.explanation: Bache sochte hain 'uniform' word ka matlab speed ka same rehna hai (acceleration 0). 'Uniform acceleration' ka matlab speed lagaatar same rate se BADH rahi hai (a = constant).

common_mistakes.title: Applying equations of motion to non-uniform cases
common_mistakes.explanation: Formulas jaise v = u + at sirf aur sirf uniform acceleration par kaam karte hain. Random curves (non-uniform) pe inhe lagana galat results dega.

recall_questions.q: What is the term for when an object's velocity changes by equal amounts in equal time intervals?
Give one real-world example of uniform acceleration.
recall_questions.answer: A freely falling body under gravity.

recall_questions.q: What does the velocity-time graph look like for uniform acceleration?

oa_questions.question: When will you say a body is in (i) uniform acceleration (ii) non-uniform acceleration?
oa_questions.answer: (i) When velocity changes by equal amounts in equal time intervals. (ii) When velocity changes by unequal amounts in equal time intervals.
oa_questions.approach: Direct definition based on the rate of change of velocity.

oa_questions.question: Is the motion of a train approaching a station uniform or non-uniform accelerated motion?
oa_questions.approach: The driver applies brakes unevenly depending on distance to platform and signals, so the rate of decrease in velocity is not strictly constant.
